sites.reason: base.WriteValue(value) with a bool argument binds to the JsonWriter.WriteValue(bool) overload, the nearest ancestor implementation.
Five arguments starting with a StringWriter bind to the TextWriter overload of the static DateTimeUtils.WriteDateTimeString, not the six-argument char[] overload.
new JsonException(message) with one string argument calls the JsonException(string message) constructor.

_values is a List<JToken>, so the receiver is a JToken and the call with a writer, token and converters binds to the virtual JToken.WriteToAsync(JsonWriter, CancellationToken, params JsonConverter[]).
v is a JValue, which inherits the internal JToken.SetLineInfo(IJsonLineInfo?, JsonLoadSettings?) overload from JToken (the other overload takes two ints).
cache is a Dictionary<StructMultiKey<Type, Type>, JsonContract>, so TryGetValue is the BCL dictionary method, not an in-repo TryGetValue.
System.Convert.ToSingle is the fully qualified BCL static method, not an in-repo conversion helper.

The static call with (object, null, bool) binds to the non-generic GetAttributes(object, Type?, bool) overload rather than the generic GetAttributes<T>(object, bool); line 785 is the branch active for the normal targets.
callArgs is declared as IList<Expression>, so Add is the BCL ICollection<T>.Add.
generator is a System.Reflection.Emit.ILGenerator, which has no Return member, so the call binds to the in-repo extension method ILGeneratorExtensions.Return(this ILGenerator).
OrderBy on IEnumerable<TMethod> binds to System.Linq.Enumerable.OrderBy; the in-repo LinqBridge copy is compiled only when HAVE_LINQ is undefined (net20 target).
targetType is a System.Type, so the instance method Type.GetFields(BindingFlags) is called; the in-repo ReflectionUtils.GetFields and TypeExtensions overloads are not involved.
